desc:
Welcome to Cut Grass for Brainrots! 🌱

Clear your path through thick grass to find hidden Brainrots! ✂️
Swing your weapon and mow down the grass to reach new zones! 🌿
Upgrade your damage to cut through tougher grass faster! 💥
Collect Brainrots to boost your income! 💸
Rebirth to earn even more and increase your attack radius ! 🔁

Support the game with a Like and join the group for future updates! 👍
